integrity: The proof is symbolic from the published finite-field component decomposition and direct paired-domination counts for complete and complete-bipartite components. Exhaustive finite-field checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the two-coordinate unit dot-product graph over finite fields only.
The component decomposition is prior work; the new contribution is the exact paired-domination enumerator and its reconstruction consequences.
No completeness claim is made for the paired-domination polynomial outside this family.
title: Paired-domination polynomials of finite-field unit dot-product graphs
